form.label: Kubernetes Audit - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed Kubernetes API server audit JSON relay overview for RBAC changes, secret access, workload changes, pod exec, authorization denials, impersonated requests, and service-account token requests. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ (kubernetes_audit_family="authz_forbidden" OR status="Forbidden" OR status=403) | stats count
index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ kubernetes_audit_family="secret_access" | stats count

index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ (kubernetes_audit_family="exec_subresource" OR kubernetes_audit_family="impersonated_request" OR kubernetes_audit_family="serviceaccount_token_request") | stats count

panel.title: Audit volume over time by family

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by kubernetes_audit_family
index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count by kubernetes_audit_family action status | sort -count

panel.title: Top API actors and source IPs

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count values(src_ip) as source_ips values(action) as actions values(kubernetes_resource) as resources by user | sort -count | head 20

index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ (kubernetes_audit_family="rbac_change" OR kubernetes_audit_family="workload_change" OR kubernetes_audit_family="secret_access") | table _time user src_ip action kubernetes_namespace kubernetes_resource kubernetes_resource_name status kubernetes_audit_id marker | sort -_time | head 50

panel.title: Exec, impersonation, token-request, and authorization-denial review

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ (kubernetes_audit_family="exec_subresource" OR kubernetes_audit_family="impersonated_request" OR kubernetes_audit_family="serviceaccount_token_request" OR kubernetes_audit_family="authz_forbidden" OR kubernetes_subresource="exec" OR kubernetes_subresource="token" OR impersonated_user=* OR status="Forbidden" OR status=403) | table _time user impersonated_user src_ip user_agent action kubernetes_namespace kubernetes_resource kubernetes_resource_name kubernetes_subresource request_kind token_audience token_expiration_seconds bound_object_kind bound_object_name status url kubernetes_audit_id marker | sort -_time | head 50
index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count values(action) as verbs values(status) as statuses by kubernetes_namespace kubernetes_resource | sort -count | head 20

panel.title: Source, sourcetype, and host onboarding coverage

search.query: index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | stats count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(kubernetes_audit_family) as families by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

index=main sourcetype="kubernetes:audit" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host source user impersonated_user src_ip user_agent action status signature signature_id kubernetes_audit_family kubernetes_namespace kubernetes_resource kubernetes_resource_name kubernetes_subresource request_kind token_audience token_expiration_seconds bound_object_kind bound_object_name url marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
